run_pipeline_image_preferences: run the distilabel pipeline to generate synthetic image preference data and push to Hugging Face Hub
create_image_generation_task: create an ImageGeneration task step that generates images from text prompts using a Hugging Face inference endpoint
build_inference_endpoints_image_llm: build an InferenceEndpointsImageLLM class that calls text-to-image endpoints and returns base64 encoded images
create_category_selector_step: create a CategorySelector step that randomly assigns art style categories and subcategories to image prompts
run_text_generation_augmentation: run text generation steps to create quality enhanced and style enhanced prompts using LLM inference endpoints
